sources.model: mortality measures: NCHS death records by county of residence, Census Population Estimates denominators, missing for fewer than 20 deaths; BRFSS measures: CDC PLACES model estimates (multilevel logistic regression and post-stratification (MRP) of BRFSS responses: individual age, sex, race/ethnicity and education; county share of adults below 150% of the poverty line (ACS 5-year); state and county random effects; applied to census block population counts and aggregated to tracts. Within a county a tract's estimate varies only with its age, sex, race/ethnicity and education composition: the model has no tract-level health information)
